name: Place Vendôme — the fronts
note: Hardouin-Mansart's façades, one design round the octagon, standing over the restyled walls: render/landmarks/paris/bugs/vendome.ts. The restyle above (paris.json) holds the houses at one eaves.

name: Presbytère de Saint-Germain-des-Prés
note: The low stone annex on the Place Saint-Germain-des-Prés, in front of the tower (aerial; a Haussmann block with shopfronts until now).

name: Notre-Dame-du-Liban
note: The Jesuits' chapel of 1894, hemmed in between the Foyer franco-libanais and the Institut Curie: a Gothic nave with its apse to the north-east and no tower. The kit's tower stood through the neighbours' roofs (owner, 2026-10-31).

name: La couverture des voies d'Austerlitz
note: The slabs across the track bed at Paris Rive Gauche, and the open cuts between them (owner, 2026-10-31): traced from the aerial, u and v in the builder. Base at the cut's floor.

name: Le terre-plein du Pont Neuf
note: The platform Henri IV stands on, level with the bridge, its stone walls down to the Vert-Galant and its stairs (owner, 2026-10-31; aerial). The bake levels the ground and clears OSM's steps: regions.json levelGrounds and flatStreets.
